name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 27 times in 9 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 54 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 20 hours starting 2025-12-14, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 4.28 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
